github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: All generated code must use fictional Contoso Assurance data only. Never generate real policy numbers, real names, real phone numbers, or real dates of birth.

github.copilot.chat.testGeneration.instr.text: Use POL-1001 / 1990-02-14 / 4821 (Asha Sharma, CUS-1001) as the primary happy-path test record. Every test suite must include at least one cross-customer access test that expects authorized=false.

github.copilot.chat.reviewSelection.inst.text: When reviewing, check: (1) no real customer data, (2) all inputs trimmed and normalised before comparison, (3) opaque error codes used — never expose which field failed, (4) confirmed=true checked before any write action, (5) no raw connector errors returned to the agent.

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Commit messages must follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): short description. Types: feat, fix, docs, test, chore, security. Example: docs(flows): add VerifyCustomer filter expression. Never include policy numbers, DOB values, or phone digits in commit messages.
